basis: amplitude correlation > 0.9 between pogo-grid neighbours (rerun/det7_pogo/corr_feu6.npz); pogo grid from the M1 gerbers (m1_trace.py); strips named by the FEU channel of the linear map (mx17_m1_map.csv)
forward_model_note: a net of n shorted channels: each channel reads (1/n) x the sum of the net's strip signals (n low-impedance inputs tied together share the charge); treat the net as ONE virtual channel with a comb of strips and a free gain, and drop the n-1 duplicates from the likelihood
